scope: Deterministic local information diagnostics and analytic prior reference; no holdout, no inference on consumed spectra, no training.
likelihood: independent Gaussian with mean mu and variance mu/P, P=(reference_SNR/(0.30*contrast))**2
normalization_cases: one global factor fixed by nominal known-axis B=45 uT bias=1000 uT reference; reused for every bias and field
direction_rule: For known-axis diagnostic use cos_theta=1 and explicitly label a changed estimand. For general direction use theta,phi; flag coordinate singularities and use Cartesian cross-checks. Do not treat center and temperature as independent identifiable parameters.

jacobian_steps.requirements: scaled coordinates; central finite differences; stable convergence within 2% for nonzero derivatives; reference analytic Lorentzian within 1e-5 relative or justified absolute floor

rank_rule: Use scaled Jacobian SVD. Report singular values and cutoff sensitivity (1e-8,1e-10,1e-12 relative). Any target component in a null direction gives unbounded, never a favorable pseudoinverse number.
metrics: local target standard-deviation bound in uT
analytic projection-only Bayes MAE and prior constant MAE/RMSE

analytic_prior.warning: Projection-only oracle is not an absolute bound for the full Hamiltonian.

parity: Manufactured spectra only, unchanged pinned nv-sensor-sim source and installed SimOS. Pin hashes and actual versions. Compare forward predictions to 1e-8 absolute where deterministic; flag branch/normalization/interpolation kinks.
gate: No claim of all-estimator impossibility from CRLB. Continue to fresh bias test only after stable source parity/derivatives and an interpretable improvement at equal bin/photon and common-amplitude budgets. Root records decision before Stage 2.
stopping_rules: No retired spectra or seeds; no old final generation.
One registered grid only. No numerical retries except one changed approach for a diagnosed implementation fault, within caps.
Stop at derivative/parity failure, cap, lock conflict or uninterpretable rank. Save failure evidence.
No Stage 2 generation before separate frozen protocol and custody approval by root.
